questions.prompt: How many simultaneous shared references (`&T`) to a single value are allowed at the same time?

options.c: Any number of shared references may coexist

questions.prompt: After passing `&primary` into `longest_len(&primary, &backup)`, what happens to ownership of `primary`?

options.b: Ownership remains with `main` because `longest_len` only borrowed a read-only reference
